blocks.name: background-gradient
blocks.title: Background — soft gradient
blocks.description: Two soft colour glows on a dark base. Put it on the bottom track under titles and screenshots.

blocks.name: callout-arrow-label
blocks.title: Callout — arrow and label
blocks.description: A hand-drawn style arrow that sweeps in, with a label at its tail.

blocks.name: callout-highlight-box
blocks.title: Callout — highlight box
blocks.description: A rounded outline that draws around a part of the screen. Resize it with the clip's scale or widthPx/heightPx.

blocks.name: callout-step-badge
blocks.title: Callout — step badge
blocks.description: A numbered circle that pops in with a pulse ring. Mark the order of steps on screen.

blocks.name: callout-tooltip
blocks.title: Callout — tooltip
blocks.description: A dark tooltip with a pointer arrow. Place it beside the control you're talking about.

blocks.name: caption-bold-pop
blocks.title: Captions — bold pop
blocks.description: Big uppercase words, the active one enlarged in yellow with a heavy outline. The short-form social look.

blocks.name: caption-boxed
blocks.title: Captions — boxed
blocks.description: Calm sentence-case captions on a dark box, with the active word on a coloured highlight. Readable over any footage.

blocks.name: caption-karaoke
blocks.title: Captions — karaoke
blocks.description: Every spoken word lights up and stays lit, on a soft shadow. Clear for music and podcasts.

blocks.name: caption-minimal
blocks.title: Captions — minimal
blocks.description: Plain white sentence-case captions with a light shadow: closest to broadcast subtitles.

blocks.name: cursor-arrow
blocks.title: Cursor — arrow
blocks.description: A crisp pointer cursor. Keyframe its x/y (or let a cursor planner do it) to show where to click.

blocks.name: cursor-click
blocks.title: Cursor — click ripple
blocks.description: An expanding ring that marks a click. Drop one at each click position for half a second.

blocks.name: intro-kinetic-headline
blocks.title: Intro — kinetic headline
blocks.description: An eyebrow line, then a headline that rises in, with a gradient second line. Full frame on a dark background.

blocks.name: intro-logo-reveal
blocks.title: Intro — brand reveal
blocks.description: A brand name pops in centre-frame with a tagline underneath.

blocks.name: lower-third-classic
blocks.title: Lower third — classic
blocks.description: Name and role on a dark card with an accent bar. Slides in and fades out on its own.

blocks.name: lower-third-gradient
blocks.title: Lower third — gradient
blocks.description: A gradient card with a name, a role and a handle. Good for creators and launch videos.

blocks.name: lower-third-minimal
blocks.title: Lower third — minimal
blocks.description: White text with a thin line that draws in. Quiet enough for documentary and interview footage.

blocks.name: lower-third-pill
blocks.title: Lower third — pill
blocks.description: A bright rounded pill with a name and a short role. Pops in.

blocks.name: outro-cta
blocks.title: End card — call to action
blocks.description: Brand, tagline and a pulsing URL button. Hold it at least 2.5 seconds.

blocks.name: progress-bar
blocks.title: Progress bar
blocks.description: A thin bar along the top that fills over the clip's length. Span the whole video for stories and tutorials.

blocks.name: title-centered
blocks.title: Title — centred over footage
blocks.description: A large centred title with a soft shadow, for over footage or images. Transparent background.

blocks.name: title-chapter
blocks.title: Title — chapter card
blocks.description: A full-frame card announcing the next part: a step number and a title. Use between sections of a tutorial.
